Under mask_parties the mailing name, every address line and the flat address are shortened like a party name; the PIN code, state and country are returned under every mode.

Measured on one synthetic book, eight ledgers: TallyPrime 7.1 Silver with one party holding one dated entry, and TallyPrime 7.2 with that party holding two; three or more entries, an entry with no date, a book of many populated parties and other releases are not measured. The read is admitted at 5,000 bytes a ledger instead of 3,750, above the largest row measured (4,902 bytes: a party with two short dated entries), not a bound; a populated party with two entries is larger; a large book may be read in more parts or refused as too large.
